newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lonrho SAfrica locks out 9,000 miners-union.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho SAfrica locks out 9,000 miners-union.

text.p: The National Union of Mineworkers said Lonrho Plc's Western North Platinum mine in South Africa had locked out 9,000 mineworkers since last Friday.

The NUM said in a statement on Monday that workers had been locked out following a two-hour sit-in to protest against the appointment of a new underground manager, who they claimed had changed workplace regulations without consulting the union.

"We are concerned about workplace consultation which the new manager is violating and the management gives him upper hand in everything," the NUM's Rustenburg Regional Secretary Sydwell Aokolwana said.
Workers from Lonrho's Rustenburg mines held a mass meeting on Monday to discuss the issue, the statement said.
